notes: The mod.sme payload occupies the PE overlay up to the 27-byte OSSM directory/footer.
The footer proves that 0x001a9200 is not merely an accidental PE overlay boundary; the container itself records that exact payload file offset.

The 4 KiB entropy profile detects a sharp statistical transition at the window beginning 0x00201000: the preceding region is high entropy and subsequent windows become strongly structured. This is not yet treated as an exact codec/serialization boundary.
No application protocol constants should be promoted to verified status until independently supported by documentation, captures, or reproducible reference behavior.

sme_profile.interpretation: statistical transition only; exact codec/object boundary unverified
